svg.title: What changed between releases
svg.desc: Grid of user administration behaviour on RHEL 7, 8, 9, 10 and Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, 26.04: password hash, lockout module, ssh-keygen default key, home directory mode, SUB_UID_MIN, useradd -n, passwd --stdin, what passwd -l writes, passwd -S output, whether newusers sets passwords, lastlog, lastb, groupmems, lid, the authentication config tool and the DEFAULT:SHA1 crypto policy.
svg.text: User administration behaviour on RHEL 7.9, 8.10, 9.8, 10.2 and Ubuntu 20.04, 22.04, 24.04, 26.04
both: pam_tally2 and pam_faillock are installed. Ubuntu ships pam_faillock but doesn't enable it. RHEL 9 switched to Ed25519 with OpenSSH 9.9 in 9.7.
passwd -S long: ends in (Password set, SHA512 crypt.). newusers on RHEL 10 leaves the accounts locked (!): set passwords with chpasswd.
